label: The VC
name: vc
plan_intro: Here is what I need to see in the next thirty days to get excited again. Consider it your milestone plan for the bridge round.
signoff: Keep me posted. My door is open, my term sheet is not, yet.

verdicts.A: This is a fund-returner record. Clean comms, consistent shipping, metrics up and to the right. We should talk about your next round.
verdicts.B: Solid traction. The fundamentals are there, the story is mostly coherent, there is a path to an A here.
verdicts.C: Interesting market, concerning execution. The commit cadence suggests a pivot looking for a problem.
verdicts.D: I am going to be honest: the data room is a mess. Messages with no narrative, burn with no milestones.
verdicts.F: This is a pre-revenue, pre-product, pre-everything record. I respect the hustle. I am passing.
